IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Schual-Berke, Green, Morrell, Wood and Springer

Bill.BriefDescription: Providing for the use of arbitration in resolving medical staff disputes regarding membership and privileges.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the use of arbitration in resolving medicalstaff disputes regarding membership and privileges; adding a newsection to chapter 70.41 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 71.12RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that there is a stronginterest in the prompt resolution of disputes between practitionerswith medical staff membership and hospitals regarding privileges andmembership disputes. The legislature finds that the use of arbitrationcan expedite resolution of those disputes after the hospital governingauthority has made a decision.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.41 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Hospital governing authorities may require that disputes regardingadmitting privileges or membership be resolved by arbitration after thegoverning authority has made its final decision. The hospital mayrequire the practitioner to pay up to onehalf of the costs of the p. 1 HB 1783arbitrator and may require that the prevailing party pay the attorneys'fees of the other party only where the arbitrator finds the appeal wasfrivolous.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 71.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Hospital governing authorities may require that disputes regardingadmitting privileges or membership be resolved by arbitration after thegoverning authority has made its final decision. The hospital mayrequire the practitioner to pay up to onehalf of the costs of thearbitrator and may require that the prevailing party pay the attorneys'fees of the other party only where the arbitrator finds the appeal wasfrivolous.
